The authors' O,N-bidentate IM5 with one inner-sphere OTf is a reference; equivalent binding models supported by evidence are permitted. Ranking IM5A/B/C, matching a binding energy or determining complete solution speciation is not required. Merely constructing the correct identities, an isolated catalyst or repeating a Lewis-acid label is insufficient.

reference_issues: Do not borrow achiral Ni(ClO4)2/DCM energies for the chiral Ni(OTf)2/CHCl3 system. IM6 +2.3 is a plotted height; its increment relative to IM5 −4.7 is +7.0. The +1/triplet model is a reference reconstruction, not a known input fact.
